item.title: Version 0.6.4
item.description:
What's New

  • Settings ▸ Advanced gains Reset All Settings — it also drops the display caches and rebuilds every running wallpaper, so the reset is a real one
  • The scene inspector now says when a scene publishes nothing to adjust, instead of showing a blank column that looks like it is still loading

Improvements

  • The frame-rate cap is now a fraction of your display's refresh rate — full, half, third or quarter. A display only ever wakes on its own refresh, so the old fixed numbers could not all be honoured: on a 60 Hz panel "24 FPS" actually ran at 30. Existing settings migrate on load
  • Failures say what went wrong: a blocked network no longer reports "unrecognized response", a wallpaper that stopped no longer shows the bare word "Error", and a rejected API key no longer claims it was stored
  • Results in Browse no longer reflow the grid as they arrive — the placeholder is the same shape as a real card

Bug Fixes

  • A display whose overlay layout could not be read came back wearing a default layout you never chose; the unreadable entry is dropped instead
  • A click on a scene could be swallowed by the release that followed it
  • A layer script driven only by a timer reported a fixed value instead of its real output, and video commands sent from a timer were dropped
  • A cancelled lyrics lookup was remembered as "no lyrics found"

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen Pro.app" once; updates Loomscreen Pro installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
